sloka: वास चूर्णैः च विविधैर् मृष्टाः तैः तैः पृथक् पृथक् ।सम्तता शुशुभे भूमिर् माल्यैः च बहु सम्स्थितैः ॥५-११-२१॥
transliteration: vāsa cūrṇaiḥ ca vividhair mṛṣṭāḥ taiḥ taiḥ pṛthak pṛthak ।samtatā śuśubhe bhūmir mālyaiḥ ca bahu samsthitaiḥ ॥5-11-21॥

translations.english: (The banquet hall) appeared beautiful with many kinds of garlands arranged in different locations. Also there were vessels made of pure gold, crystalware and jars spread all over.
